info.description: Rave — hackathon submission and judging platform. Every procedure below is reachable over POST /rpc/<router>/<procedure> with an oRPC JSON body of {"json": <input>}. The declared method and path below are the intended REST shape; see docs/ARCHITECTURE.md for why the runtime serves RPC framing instead.
